scope: Scoped discovery Google Calendar create/retry/cancel using actual managed worker and owned private event

tests.name: owner UI explicitly authorizes both tentative selection and one-request Google mirroring
anonymous mobile client submits availability and loses fragment from history
actual managed worker books and syncs the inherited calendar authority
real Google event is private and tentative with zero guests and no reminder emails
anonymous callers cannot access owner event previews
reviewed repeat sync retains the same resource identity and no invitations
owner desktop pause and fresh-preview reauthorization keep the same event
mobile calendar controls fit the page and remain single
owner cancellation produces an actual Google cancellation on the same identity
request sync policy is disabled after provider cleanup and interview policy is preserved
synthetic local meeting and its Google event are cancelled before policy cleanup
contact opted out and review chase/campaign cancelled without mail

limitations: No participant invitations, attendance/identity verification or Google Meet creation
External edit/unknown creation races positively covered with local provider simulation and MySQL; live external overwrite was not forced
No automatic cleanup/migration across changed calendars or accounts
Discovery reminders, expiry SLA and actual recipient email delivery remain pending
